tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search for service businesses by location. Returns businesses with their booking URLs, ratings, and descriptions. Use get_business to see services and get_availability to check open slots.

location.description: City, city+state, or zip code. E.g. 'Brooklyn NY', 'Austin, TX', '90210'

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Get full details for a business including services (with IDs and prices), staff, and hours. You need service_id and optionally staff_id before calling book_appointment.

slug.description: The business slug from search_businesses results

business_slug.description: Alias for slug — the business slug from search_businesses results

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Get open appointment slots for a business on a specific date. Returns ISO timestamps for each available slot. Use these start_time/end_time values when calling book_appointment.

business_slug.description: The business slug from search_businesses results

date.description: Date to check in YYYY-MM-DD format

staff_id.description: Specific staff member ID (from get_business). Omit to check any available staff.

timezone.description: IANA timezone string (e.g. 'America/New_York'). Defaults to business local time.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Reserve an appointment slot at a service business. Provide a unique idempotency_key to safely retry without double-booking. Get service_id from get_business and start_time/end_time from get_availability.

business_slug.description: The business slug from search_businesses results

service_id.description: The service ID from get_business results

start_time.description: ISO 8601 datetime for the appointment start (from get_availability)

end_time.description: ISO 8601 datetime for the appointment end (from get_availability)

staff_id.description: Staff member ID (from get_business). Omit to auto-assign.

notes.description: Any special requests or notes for the business

idempotency_key.description: Unique key to prevent duplicate bookings (e.g. UUID). Reuse the same key to safely retry.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Look up the current status/time of a booking you made. Requires the booking_id and the lookup_token that book_appointment returned. No account needed.

lookup_token.description: The lookup_token returned from book_appointment for this booking

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel a booking you made. Requires booking_id and the lookup_token from book_appointment. Safe to retry (idempotent). No account needed.

lookup_token.description: The lookup_token returned from book_appointment for this booking

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.description: Move a booking you made to a new time. Requires booking_id, the lookup_token from book_appointment, and new_start_time/new_end_time (ISO 8601, from get_availability). The new slot is checked for conflicts. No account needed.

lookup_token.description: The lookup_token returned from book_appointment for this booking

new_start_time.description: ISO 8601 datetime for the new appointment start (from get_availability)

new_end_time.description: ISO 8601 datetime for the new appointment end (from get_availability)

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Get a BookingMaven signup link pre-filled with the customer's details. The customer visits the link to set their password and activate their account, which links their past bookings.

email.description: Customer email (use the same email used for booking)

tools.name: start_business_signup
tools.description: Get a link for a business owner to sign up and list their business on BookingMaven. Returns a URL with optional pre-filled details.

tools.name: list_my_bookings
tools.description: List all appointments booked with your email address. Requires signing in (OAuth) — your AI must be connected with an authenticated account that has a verified email. Returns your upcoming and past bookings.

tools.name: link_account
tools.description: Link the guest bookings you made with your email to your signed-in account so you can manage them from your account. Requires signing in (OAuth) with a verified email.
